QuestInfo.name: [Tower of Oz] Tower Under the Sea
QuestInfo.1: Alicia's Soul, the last trace of the Transcendent of Life and World Tree, was discovered in a strange tower in the northern reaches of Maple World. Your assistance is needed in exploring the tower.
QuestInfo.2: Alicia created a tower called the Tower of Oz in the distant past. Inside she kept the seeds of life on Maple World should the Black Mage win and destroy everything.
